scope: Phase 4 testing tooling boundaries. Inventory only; do not install dependencies or run live/browser/DB checks from this file.

tools.name: CloakBrowser
tools.purpose: Provide a stable real browser executable for Playwright browser suites and UIUX evidence.
tools.governance: Use as browser runtime only; assertions, traces, screenshots, and pass/fail decisions belong to Playwright scripts and release dashboard reports.

tools.name: Yingdao RPA
tools.purpose: Replay human-like UAT paths across browser, desktop files, uploads, downloads, and external workflows.
tools.governance: Treat as UAT assistance. Findings must be converted into repeatable Playwright, Vitest, API, or contract tests before becoming hard release gates.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.purpose: Drive exploratory browser investigation and help convert findings into repeatable scripts.
tools.governance: Do not count exploratory MCP observations as pass. Convert stable findings into versioned scripts and dashboard reports.

tools.name: MSW
tools.purpose: Provide deterministic frontend/component/page data when backend or DB state is unstable.
tools.governance: Use for local_browser_msw gates only. MSW can prove deterministic UI behavior against mocked API contracts, but it cannot close live or DB readiness gates.

tools.name: GitHub Actions Postgres service container
tools.purpose: Run backend integration slices against an ephemeral PostgreSQL service instead of a real Supabase database.

requires: migration and seed command that targets DB_CONNECTION_STRING

tools.governance: Use only for container_db gates after the workflow and migration command are reviewed. This does not replace Supabase RLS, Advisor, storage, or live migration evidence.

tools.name: Testcontainers PostgreSQL
tools.purpose: Start disposable PostgreSQL containers for backend integration tests in local and CI environments.
tools.governance: Do not add until local Docker capacity and disk budget are acceptable. Prefer GitHub Actions service containers first on this machine.

tools.name: Schemathesis
tools.purpose: Run OpenAPI contract and fuzz tests after an authoritative API artifact exists.
tools.governance: Do not add before API contracts are authoritative. Fuzz only against a safe test target.

tools.name: Argos or Lost Pixel
tools.purpose: Provide PR-level visual diff review when Playwright screenshot volume exceeds local review capacity.
tools.governance: Use after local visual baselines stabilize. Do not replace semantic/UI assertions.

tools.name: k6 or Artillery
tools.purpose: Exercise critical API flows under load after budgets and safe test targets are stable.
tools.governance: Never point load tests at production without explicit environment ownership, budget, and rollback controls.

tools.name: OWASP ZAP Baseline
tools.purpose: Run pre-release security smoke scans with explicit false-positive review.
tools.governance: Security findings require triage. A clean smoke scan is not a full penetration test.
